payload.title: delta 2 残差结构：结构化未建模动力学，不能靠噪声分离复活

payload.verdict: EL residual is structured (high lag-1 autocorrelation ~0.56-0.65), not white noise. delta 2 cannot be revived by noise separation; requires stronger structural identification.
payload.implication: delta 1 (finite-data closed-loop bound) and delta 3 (unified bound) would be dominated by the same structured residual and yield vacuous bounds unless the residual is modeled.
